title: CONSIDER: A. PROGRAMMING an amount not-to-exceed $35 million in Measure M I-710 South Corridor Project (now the LB-ELA CMIP) Highway Capital Funds as…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0662, Project]
[PLANNING AND PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (6-0):]
CONSIDER: 

A.	PROGRAMMING an amount not-to-exceed $35 million in Measure M I-710 South Corridor Project (now the LB-ELA CMIP) Highway Capital Funds as funding augmentation for the Shoreline Drive Realignment Project, subject to contingencies including partial repayment (Attachment A);

B.	AMENDING the FY 2027 Budget to accommodate this programming action; and

C.	AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer or their designee to negotiate and execute all necessary agreements with the City of Long Beach.
summary: Metro Board programs $35 million in Measure M funds for the Shoreline Drive Realignment Project in Long Beach.
